lead_raw_text:
The structure of Th₂AlNi crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Th₈Al₄Ni₄) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al and Ni each adopt tetrahedral coordination with 4 Th neighbors, while Th is surrounded by 8 neighbors (4 Al, 4 Ni). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Al and Ni tetrahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Th and Al/Ni polyhedra.
